result.question: What does Zebul tell Gaal to do?

readings.answer: Go out now and fight them.
readings.support: Go out now and fight them!

assessments.reason: In 9:38 Zebul says, “Go out now and fight them!” right after referencing Abimelech and his men, so “them” refers to Abimelech’s forces; telling Gaal to fight them matches “Fight Abimelech.”

result.reason: Zebul’s line “Go out now and fight them!” following his mention of Abimelech shows he’s telling Gaal to fight Abimelech and his men.
